shots.focal_element: Jira Product Discovery views in a Chrome window: All Ideas list, Roadmap board, Timeline view, Impact vs. Effort matrix, a new 'Sales' list grouped by Key customers, and the Share popover
on_screen_text: Templates increase user engagement and productivity
Select a field. The different values of that field will be swimlanes in your list.
shots.typography: Native product UI text only: sans-serif (Atlassian UI font, low-confidence guess), semibold view titles ('All Ideas', 'Roadmap', 'Sales'), regular small body and table text, sentence case, default tracking; no added captions, lower thirds or kinetic type
shots.what_happens: Opens (hard cut) on a web article with the Chrome extension popover confirming 'Insight successfully added' (about 60-63 s), then returns to the 'Onboarding templates' idea and the full All Ideas list as the VO says all ideas and insights are in one place (w188-w200) and introduces prioritising with views (w201-w238). The cursor clicks through the sidebar views: Roadmap board (w239-w253), Timeline view (w254-w266), Impact vs. Effort matrix with hover tooltips on bubbles (w267-w289). It opens 'Create a view' > 'Create a new list' (w290-w328), the frame punches in as 'New View' is renamed 'Sales', Group by is set to 'Key customers' and fields are toggled in the Fields panel (w329-w356), then reframes out. On the Roadmap board it punches in again while a card is dragged between columns and the Columns field is switched to Impact (w381-w415), reframes out, and opens Share, toggles 'Share view in full screen' and clicks 'Copy link' to a 'Copied' toast (w416-w431). From about 132 s to the end of the shot (171.5 s; timeline sharing w432-w470 and Jira Software delivery linking w471-w555 in the VO) the frames were not in my packet, so those visuals are not described.
shots.build_rebuild: Play the continuous screen capture full-bleed and keyframe an eased CSS scale/translate crop (about 1.0 to 1.3) onto the active panel at each narration step (rename field, group-by panel, dragged card), easing back to the full browser frame between features while the real cursor performs the clicks.
